passages.title: International Home and Office Fair
lines: Welcome to the International Home and Office Fair at the Chicago Convention Center! Every year, this exhibition attracts more than 20,000 visitors. It is one of the biggest in the industry.
This year, 320 companies from 28 countries are here with a wide variety of products for the home and the office. Sales representatives are at every booth to answer your questions.
Area A: companies from North America. Area B: companies from the Asia region. Area C: companies from Europe.
Thursday is for business visitors only (10:00 to 6:00). Friday and Saturday are open to everyone (9:00 to 5:00).
The information desk in Area A opens one hour before the fair each day. Ask there for a free guide with a map of every booth.
Every afternoon at two, companies show their newest products in Area C. Last year, visitors ordered more than twelve million dollars of products.
